experiment: Learn lower-body reference corrections with immutable TWIST2
training_data: 66 existing Quest train clips (33 originals + mirrors); no author motions in this focused adapter pilot
validation: 12 existing Quest validation clips x3 modes x2 goal signs =72 first-episode trials; exact initial-state digest checked
architecture: 1467 input features ->256 ELU ->128 ELU ->12 latent corrections; tanh *.5rad; EMA alpha .2; hard URDF joint limits. Goals, upper body and TWIST2 weights immutable. Source body rewards use FK of corrected q.
new_objectives: Corrected-reference imitation + source physics regularization + velocity-weighted actual sole clearance + camera-goal progress/remaining distance + correction regularity. Explicit experiment, not author-training reproduction.
runtime: Not integrated or deployed; adapter includes state features available inside the Quest simulator. C++ integration and MuJoCo/ONNX parity still required before headset use.
pipeline: four blocks of500 additional optimizer updates, each followed by72env paired validation
complete at2300 cumulative updates; no deployment

notes: r1-r6 failures were pre-training integration checks; no performance-based early stopping.
Wrapper observations use exact simulated proprioception. Upstream observation noise affects unused upstream buffers, not adapter/tracker inputs.
